views.definition:
SELECT m.id,
    m.bracket_id,
    m.round,
    m.slot,
    m.team_a,
    m.team_b,
    m.team_a_locked,
    m.team_b_locked,
    m.predicted_winner,
    m.predicted_winner_games,
    m.next_match_id,
    m.next_slot,
    m.created_at,
    m.updated_at,
    b.user_id
   FROM (matches m
     JOIN brackets b ON ((b.id = m.bracket_id)));
